packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates - the unbound version bump is the one that matters most here, and this is what keeps it from going stale the way pixelfederation/unbound's own PRs did.
Actions bumps touch the release and GHCR-publish workflows, where a bad version fails quietly instead of turning CI red. Digests stay pinned by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver; merge by hand.
Base-image digest refreshes are content-identical rebuilds; CI is enough.

release-please only cuts a release from fix/feat commits, and Renovate's default for a Dockerfile ARG bump is chore(deps). This repo exists specifically to track NLnetLabs/unbound releases, so that bump has to read as a fix or it would merge cleanly and never actually ship.
